headline: African Credit Rating Agency Targets March for First Ratings
summary: The African Credit Rating Agency (AfCRA) aims to release its first sovereign credit ratings by the end of March 2027 following government engagements.
why: AfCRA is an independent ratings agency designed to provide localized risk assessments for African sovereign issuers, potentially lowering borrowing costs.

impacts.name: Sovereign Debt
impacts.why: New credit ratings provide alternative benchmarks for African sovereign debt markets.
